findings.desc: Blocking test coverage gap: the quantum claim-admissibility smoke covers missing identity fields and identity/verifier mismatches, but it does not directly exercise stale receipt rejection or missing required receipt rejection, despite the reviewer checklist requiring deterministic stale/missing/mismatched binding checks. The evaluator has stale_evidence and missing_required_receipt branches, and the package script passes, but this story coverage does not prove those branches.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 105b780d9 by adding direct smoke assertions for missing_required_receipt and stale_evidence; verified with npm --prefix packages/main run test:quantum-claim-admissibility showing both cases BLOCK and final smoke passed.

findings.desc: Blocking quality issue: basisOrGrid claims are specified as accepting a basis-set or grid identity, but buildRequiredIdentityFields always adds gridHash for basisOrGrid claims. A valid basis-set-only Q2/Q5/Q9/Q10 receipt with matching basisSetHash and no gridHash will be blocked by identity_mismatch/missing receipt field handling, contradicting the M1 schema/API semantics and making the evaluator over-specific to grid workflows.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 105b780d9 by allowing basisOrGrid claims to bind through either matching basisSetHash or matching gridHash while still failing closed on missing basis/grid identity and mismatches; verified by smoke cases valid Q5 basis-set-only evidence PASS, mismatched basisSetHash BLOCK, and missing basis/grid identity BLOCK.

findings.desc: Hard-stop fail-closed reasons are masked by weak_evidence_overclaim in classifyNextAction. In packages/main/src/core/claim-admissibility/quantum.ts:321-330, the function returns degrade whenever any weak_evidence_overclaim reason exists before checking stop-class reasons such as identity_mismatch, verifier_script_mismatch, stale_evidence, unbound_solver_output, or claim_boundary_violation. A Q5 input that both overclaims ground-state and has mismatched or stale evidence remains allowed=false, but nextAction becomes degrade and scopedClaim becomes true, implying a weaker scoped claim can survive even though the evidence is not bound/current. This conflicts with the M0-M1 fail-closed requirement and is not covered by packages/main/src/tasks/quantum-claim-admissibility-smoke.ts, which only tests weak overclaim with otherwise valid evidence.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 90a4493f by prioritizing hard-stop reasons over weak_evidence_overclaim in classifyNextAction; smoke now covers weak ground-state overclaim combined with stale_evidence and asserts BLOCK/stop/no scoped claim. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build and npm --prefix packages/main run test:quantum-claim-admissibility.

findings.desc: Blocking quality issue after F-003: classifyNextAction hard-stop priority still excludes missing identity reasons. packages/main/src/core/claim-admissibility/quantum.ts:244-257 omits missing_core_identity_field, missing_conditional_identity_field, missing_claim_field, and missing_basis_or_grid_identity from HARD_STOP_REASON_PREFIXES, so packages/main/src/core/claim-admissibility/quantum.ts:336-343 returns degrade when any of those missing-identity reasons appears together with weak_evidence_overclaim. The result remains allowed=false, but packages/main/src/core/claim-admissibility/quantum.ts:512-520 then exposes nextAction=degrade and scopedClaim=true, implying a weaker scoped claim can survive even though required evidence identity is missing. This conflicts with the M0-M1 plan requirement that missing evidence fail closed, and the smoke only asserts hard-stop priority for stale_evidence plus weak overclaim at packages/main/src/tasks/quantum-claim-admissibility-smoke.ts:111-119, leaving missing-core/conditional/basis-grid plus overclaim untested.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 4c8898c9 by adding missing_core_identity_field, missing_conditional_identity_field, missing_claim_field, and missing_basis_or_grid_identity to hard-stop classification; smoke now covers missing basis/grid identity combined with weak_evidence_overclaim and asserts BLOCK/stop/no scoped claim. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build and npm --prefix packages/main run test:quantum-claim-admissibility.
